scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @redlady/core test && pnpm --filter @redlady/db test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.tenant:create: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @redlady/db exec tsx src/cli.ts create
scripts.migrate:all: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @redlady/db exec tsx src/cli.ts migrate-all
scripts.tenant:move: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @redlady/db exec tsx src/cli.ts move
